peircean_analysis.firstness: mcu.bin: Sony Ericsson P800 MCU firmware, 4MB, 2004-09-21. String analysis yields GSM protocol stack process table (FrameTick, SIMRX, LH_RX, LH_TX, LLC, RLC, MPH, MM, SM, GCC, UICC, SIMTOOL, SNDCP, PPP, RLPH, VoiceNote, GDFS_Server/Write/Erase). No high-entropy blocks. No user-generated content.
peircean_analysis.secondness: This is the device's baseband firmware — the radio protocol stack. It contains no user data partition, no SMS storage, no contact database, no call log, no image storage. The artifact is structurally valid firmware with no forensically analyzable user content.
peircean_analysis.thirdness: No intentionality inference is possible from firmware binary. There is no actor behavior encoded in this artifact. Any verdict beyond ABSTAIN would be speculation.

hypotheses.H1_forensic_evidence: mcu.bin contains evidence of user behavior or intent.
hypotheses.H2_firmware_only: mcu.bin is device firmware with zero user-generated content — no forensic inference possible.

refutation_protocol.benign_hypothesis: H2 is the observation, not a hypothesis. mcu.bin is firmware by examination.
refutation_protocol.test_result: H1 fully refuted by string analysis (GSM stack processes, no user data structures).
refutation_protocol.refutation_outcome: ABSTAIN is the only valid verdict. Case itself states this explicitly.
